title: Add Two Numbers
description: Write a program to take two integers as input and print their sum.
inputFormat: A single line containing two space-separated integers, `a` and `b`.
outputFormat: Print a single integer representing the sum of `a` and `b`.

title: Even or Odd
description: Write a program to check whether a given integer is even or odd. Print 'Even' if it is even, otherwise print 'Odd'.
inputFormat: A single line containing an integer `n`.

title: Find Maximum of Three
description: Write a program to take three space-separated integers as input and print the maximum among them.
inputFormat: A single line containing three space-separated integers.
outputFormat: Print a single integer representing the maximum value.
